items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we’re filming in San Diego, California for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m pleased to have a saxophonist from overseas, and welcome Jim Galloway.
It’s a pleasure to have you here and I enjoyed your playing for the last couple of days.
